admitted_operations: two inherited G5 grafts forming a three-leaf tree; no extra operation

domain.motifs: all canonical three-leaf binary composition motifs whose leaves are S0 basis carriers and whose internal joins are lawful under the 31 operators
domain.orientations: both binary bracketings and every directed operator assignment admitted by the inherited grammar
domain.pass_scope: complete only if the enumerated canonical motif universe fits the registered budget; otherwise BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT
domain.quotienting: canonicalize by S1/S2 public classes but retain exact representatives

exact_equality_rule: Hashes may index/bind artifacts, but every exact scientific equality claim is decided by full structural equality of the declared carrier/outcome objects.
frozen_question: Does any irreducible residual appear in complete canonical three-leaf P3/K3 composition motifs built from the S0 basis after quotienting by the S1/S2 public classes?

observer.irreducible_residual: same complete public motif context but structurally different exact final relation not already explained by a registered S1/S2 separator
observer.primary: exact final outcome relation and all intermediate public class labels

parent_authority.public_law: enabled iff f_a>0 and g_b>0; D_out=(f+g-e_a-e_b,m+n)

promotion_constraints: Mechanical PASS never changes G5 authority.
Any new G6 public field is candidate-only until S5 earns a finite state and S6 plus explicit graduation review approve it.
Hidden topology/canon/provenance may be used as oracle evidence but cannot enter the public descriptor unless a separately registered promotion test earns it.
purpose: Higher-context residual audit beyond pair and one-step quotient tests.
stopping_rules: first decisive separator when the stage specifies first-separator stopping
